'''Elisa al'Seen''' is a [[Two Rivers]] resident and is married to [[Jac al'Seen]].

== Appearance ==
She has less gray in her hair than her husband. She has a lined and motherly face.

== Activities ==
Elisa greets [[Perrin Aybara]] when he comes to her family's farm. She was a friend of his mother, and mourns with him. She and her family offer him shelter from the Whitecloaks.{{ref/book|4|32}} 

==Name Origin==
Elisa could either be adapted from the common real-world name Elisabeth or '''Ellisande''', referring to Queen [[Eldrene ay Ellan ay Carlan]], the last Queen of [[Manetheren]].
